from: June book, night 3 (A Baby Named Obed)
p1: Boaz was a good man. He wanted to take care of Ruth and Naomi. So Boaz and Ruth got married.
Then the Lord gave them a baby boy! Naomi had been very sad. Now she held the baby close and took care of him.
Naomi’s neighbors said, “Blessed be the Lord!” They gave the baby a name. They called him Obed.
p2: Obed grew up and had a son named Jesse. Jesse’s son was David, who became a king. Many years later, Jesus was born into that same family! So Ruth is part of Jesus’s family.
You are part of a family too, and Heavenly Father loves each one. Tonight, say the name of each person in your family. Each one is a gift from Him.
old: Boaz thought Ruth was wonderful. Ruth was kind, hard-working, and loyal. Boaz wanted to take care of Ruth and Naomi.
Boaz asked Ruth to marry him. Ruth said yes! They had a beautiful wedding. Now Ruth had a loving husband who would take care of her and Naomi.
Later, Ruth and Boaz had a baby boy named Obed. Naomi was so happy to hold the baby! Ruth’s hard work and kindness led to great blessings.
Ruth’s story shows that when we’re faithful and kind, Heavenly Father blesses us. Ruth went from being sad and alone to having a family and being happy!
